text:
Ava (CS): heads-up — we have an outage impacting embeddings and reranking for some hosted customers. SRE says degraded throughput and 5xxs starting ~09:12 UTC. I need a short customer-facing status and a plan for proactive outreach.
Nico (SRE): confirmed. Root cause: a regression in cache eviction logic after yesterday's runtime deploy. KV cache thrashing caused high mem pressure and request failures. We're rolling back the deploy to the previous stable kernel now. ETA ~20-30m.
Priya (Solutions Eng): noted. Which customers are in the affected cohort? I can draft tailored notes for enterprise accounts.
Diego (Support): affected list from the alert: accounts with heavy embedding windows + dedicated requests: AcmeCorp, BrightData, FathomAI, and two small customers on shared tier. I'll DM the full list to folks with PII.
Ava (CS): thank you. Priya, please prepare a short template: 2-line incident summary, mitigation steps, ETA, and escalation contact. Elena, can you prioritize AcmeCorp and BrightData outreach after the rollback confirmation?
Elena (Acct Exec): yes, I can do AcmeCorp call + BrightData email. Quick ask: include a sentence on crediting for downtime and next steps to avoid churn.
Nico (SRE): rollback started at 09:18 UTC. Rolling back config + runtime image. Monitoring shows error rate dropping but still elevated.
IncidentBot: Deploy rollback initiated by nico-sre at 1769123820. CI job id: 987654.
Priya (Solutions Eng): drafting template now. Suggest text:
> Hi — we experienced an interruption to embeddings and reranking starting 09:12 UTC due to a runtime cache regression. We rolled back the change and are monitoring; services are returning to normal. Next steps: we will perform a postmortem, share an RCA and mitigation timeline, and offer a credit for impact. Estimated full recovery within 30 minutes. Contact: cs@redwood.ai or on-call.
Diego (Support): posting quick status to status.redwood.ai -> I'll mark "partial outage" and link to this thread. Also sending initial notice to customers with automated template.
Ava (CS): good. Priya, add a line about mitigation we've planned: stricter canary rollout gates + automated cache eviction alerts + rollback automation. Keep it short.
Priya (Solutions Eng): updated template and short subject lines for email + Slack DM. Putting both in #cs-templates.
Nico (SRE): error rate back to baseline at 09:39 UTC. Rolling additional verification for tail latency and kv hit rates.
Ava (CS): excellent. Elena, please coordinate the two enterprise touches and log any escalation requests. Diego, escalate any chargeback or billing questions to me.
Elena (Acct Exec): on it. I'll ping after the AcmeCorp call and attach call notes.
IncidentBot: Incident 2026-03-20-embeddings-cache created. Severity: SEV2. Postmortem due in 72h.
Ava (CS): action items recap: 1) SRE confirm full recovery + RCA draft (Nico) 2) CS templates + short customer notices (Priya, Diego) 3) Enterprise outreach (Elena) 4) Credits & billing path (Ava/Support) 5) Postmortem + mitigation list published in 72h. I'll compile the messages and send a final status update to affected customers once Nico confirms full recovery.
Nico (SRE): recovery confirmed at 09:39:20 UTC. KV hitrate restored; memory stabilized. We'll attach logs and timeline for RCA.
Ava (CS): final note going out in 5m to affected customers with recovery confirmation, brief RCA summary, and credits offer. Thanks everyone.
Diego (Support): sending final email now. Template header: "Service update — embeddings and reranking recovered".
Priya (Solutions Eng): saved templates and sample phrasing in #cs-templates -> filename: 2026-03-20-embeddings-outage-template.md
Elena (Acct Exec): AcmeCorp call done. They appreciated the proactive call, asked for a weekly sync next month. Logged potential renewal concern but majorly positive after the quick reachout.
Ava (CS): great follow-up. We'll include Elena's call notes in the customer record. Closing thread once postmortem is published.
Nico (SRE): posting RCA draft link: https://redwood-internal/incident/2026-03-20-embeddings-cache-rca (internal).
Ava (CS): copied. We'll share a customer-safe summary tomorrow with links to mitigations and credits. End of thread.
